summary: The implementation follows the spec's design exactly. formatChartForReview gives the header, the chart justification, a blank line, then formatSpot + 'Why: ' line per spot joined by one blank line. chartPrintMain covers no argument (byte-identical formatChart for 6-max), a valid size (review format), an unknown size including '', toString, wrong case and the six-max alias (exit 2, exact message plus usage), and 2+ arguments (exit 2). The tools entry is a thin wrapper that sets process.exitCode. The acceptance tests rebuild every block's header percentages, rank row, grid tokens and Why line from the raw JSON, in APPLICABLE_SPOTS order, so a broken formatter or a wrong order would fail them. The unit tests pin the exact out/err writes and return codes. The locked TASK-7.19 test, package.json, the chart JSON and preflop*.ts are unchanged. All 9 chart-print tests pass locally and the build gate is PASS. No blocking findings.
